# GitHub Security Advisory: Malicious Postinstall Script Execution in NPM Packages

## Advisory Overview
Severity: HIGH
Affected Versions: All npm versions (< 10.8.0)

## Description
NPM package installation automatically executes `postinstall` lifecycle scripts defined in `package.json`. Malicious third-party packages can exploit lifecycle hooks to run obfuscated shell scripts during `npm install`.

## Recommendation
Developers should use `--ignore-scripts` when installing untrusted third-party packages or enforce strict package lockfile audits.
